scenario: A `call` with kwargs of four kinds — Int, Float, String, Bool — reaches the integrator's cb as four typed arguments, each of its own kind: name/value operand pairs on FN_CALL (RDSC.4a.9.4), bridged to `ds_arg_t` by libds. Pins [NCBK.6.10]: each argument is `{ name, kind, value }`, here for the Int, Float, String and Bool kinds, sorted by name ([NCBK.6.2]). The ICOM.22.4 in its id is no clause: no document carries the ICOM prefix.
rules_ds:
service svc.x:
    kwarg i: Int
    kwarg f: Float
    kwarg s: String
    kwarg b: Bool
    no response

schema Trig scope logical:
    v: Int key

rule r:
    Trig
->
    call svc.x i: 1 f: 2.5 s: "hi" b: true nocooldown
